newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes lower as downtrend continues.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes lower as downtrend continues.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index edged lower again on Wednesday with no new factors seen affecting trading.
The PX50 fell 0.7 percent to 504.6 and the major issue dominated RPIX lost 0.5 percent to 1,030.2.
"There's nothing really new. Just the same bearishness for the same reasons," said one local dealer.
Dealers say Czech shares are moving down because of pessimism about the coutry's macro-economic prospects, poor company earnings in the first quarter and inadequate capital market regulation.
The major issues had a slightly better day than in the previous session when almost all posted heavy losses.
Neverthless, Komercni Banka fell 45 crowns, 2.25 perecnt, to 1,955, SPT Telecom dropped four crowns, 0.13 percent to 3,050, and Ceska Sporitelna fell three crowns, 0.9 percent, to 299.
Power utility CEZ edged six crowns higher to 910.
